# AUGMANITAI Master Compendium

> The main library of the AUGMANITAI Research Programme. 1,128 defined terms (EN+DE) describing observable patterns of human-AI interaction. Bilingual descriptive phenomenology. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

## About

This is the master library of the **AUGMANITAI Research Programme** by **Andreas Ehstand** — AI Researcher · Human-AI Interaction · Starnberg, Germany. Descriptive phenomenology of patterns observed when humans interact with AI systems. One page per named pattern. Bilingual EN/DE.

## Identifiers

## Methodology

Descriptive phenomenology adapted from twenty years of high-performance sport coaching. Each term documents an observable pattern without prescriptive recommendation. Bilingual throughout. Citation-ready with stable DOIs.
